title: Routing of Denials and Front-End Rejections — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Policy clause.** Every full denial and every front-end rejection of an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is worked within the denial work period by the route the reason-code routing table assigns to its reason code.

1. Correct and resubmit (missing or invalid data, CO-4, CO-11, CO-16) and every front-end rejection are fixed on the claim and resubmitted; a corrected member ID, group number or payer name is taken exactly as printed on the patient's current insurance card, as the patient reads it out or uploads it, and must match the payer class's member identifier format.
2. Provider appeal with authorization evidence (CO-197) is appealed only when an authorization or a timely admission notification exists, or when the encounter was an emergency (emergency services are exempt from authorization); otherwise a retroactive authorization is requested when the date of service is within the payer class's retroactive authorization window, and failing both the amount is written off as no authorization obtained.
3. Medical-necessity appeal (CO-50) goes to appeal with the medical records.
4. Bill the other payer first (CO-22) and bill the correct payer (CO-109) require the coverage order to be corrected with the patient and the claim billed to the right payer.
5. No action, duplicate (CO-18) needs no action.
6. A PR-27 denial (coverage terminated before the date of service) releases the amount to the patient and the encounter's financial class is corrected.
7. A PR-204 non-covered amount is released to the patient only when the payer class's advance waiver form, signed before the service, is on file (a waiver is required); without it the amount is written off as non-covered with no waiver.
8. CO-96 and every other CO, OA or PI amount (the groups never billable to the patient) are never billed to the patient.
9. The claim closes once no route remains.

The payer class's retroactive authorization window, admission notification period, prior-authorization classes and member identifier format apply.

**CO-197 decision table**

| Authorization or timely notification exists | Emergency encounter | Date of service within the retro window | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | — | — | appeal |
| no | yes | — | appeal |
| no | no | yes | request a retroactive authorization |
| no | no | no | write off as no authorization obtained |

**Member data corrections (point of judgement).** The authoritative source is the patient's current card, as the patient reads it out or uploads it; the corrected value must also fit the payer class's identifier format (for example, a 10-digit ForwardHealth member ID on a BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim).
